title: model-retire dataset
description: Deprecated and retired LLM model IDs, each read from the provider's own lifecycle page.

updated.description: Date the dataset as a whole was last re-verified.

provider.description: Provider key, for example openai, anthropic, google-vertex-ai.

id.description: The exact model ID string used in API calls.

aliases.description: Other exact strings the provider lists for the same model.

status.description: retired if the provider says so or the shutdown date had passed on the checked date.

retires_on.description: Shutdown date as published by the provider.

replacement.description: Recommended replacement, as written by the provider.

note.description: Qualifications the provider's page puts on the dates.

source.description: The official page the entry was read from.

checked.description: Date the entry was last checked against its source.
